title: null-deletion / misspelling period restoration
hypothesis: K4 is a short-period substitution with a few inserted null ciphertext letters
insights: Tested 64,897 deletion sets (1-3 nulls from the 73 non-crib positions); 0 decryptable at fully-pinned L<= 20. Best hexagram = -99.00/char.
Removing up to N salted nulls does not restore a short periodic substitution that decrypts to English. The period-displacement-by-nulls hypothesis is closed at this depth.
next_steps: extend to quad deletions (--max-deletions 4); try deletions of crib-adjacent positions
